fields.why: The text compares median sex partners between vaccination groups (3 vs 1.5) and reports a median interval of 8.4 months (IQR); these are medians of measured quantities, so continuous belongs alongside binary/categorical.
"All cases occurred among persons who were assigned male sex at birth" defines the population by sex; the brief says sex is always recorded, here with role population. The level is unaffected.

brief_issues: vaccine_outcome_type for a breakthrough-infection cluster with no VE computed: both readers chose effectiveness and cited a quote that does not mention effectiveness; the brief could say whether breakthrough case counts are effectiveness or other.
